Wands no longer scale with spell damage.

sections.summary: Mages learn Comprehend Scroll at level 6. It lets you read scrolls that drop from mobs and raises your Comprehension skill; breakpoints at 1, 15, 50 and 175 open higher scroll tiers. Scrolls now trigger the global cooldown and can't be read while moving.

facts: Mage can be Human, Gnome, Undead, Troll, Orc (new) or Skyborne (new, Alliance only, needs an upgrade pack).

latestChanges.text: 20 Oct hotfix (no Blizzard notes): Piercing Ice removed; Elemental Precision cut from 5 ranks to 3; Frostbite, Permafrost, Frost Channeling and Improved Blizzard moved within their rows.
Client 70450 (16 Oct) adds Arcane Wrath's 6 sec cooldown to the game data. No other Mage spell or talent changes listed yet; sims still run on 70425.

Fire Power reworked to 3 ranks: at 3/3, +3% Fire damage per Fire effect of yours on the target (Ignite, Improved Scorch, Fireball, Pyroblast, Impact), up to 12%. Frostfire Bolt benefits but doesn't count as an effect.
Critical Mass goes to 5 ranks for 10% Fire crit. Every Fire Blast now adds a Heating Up stack, so a crit Fire Blast gives two.
Arcane Blast redesigned: 1.5 sec cast, 40% less damage, and each cast gives you 15% of your Intellect as spell damage for 15 sec (stacks 4 times). The old +10% to other spells is gone.
New Arcane Wrath (16-point talent): 3.5 sec cast, Fireball-like damage plus spell damage equal to 5% of your max Mana, 6 sec cooldown.
Missile Barrage moves to row 1 and becomes 2 ranks (40% from Arcane Blast at 2/2, 20% from Arcane Wrath, Fireball, Frostbolt, Frostfire Bolt, 10% per Missiles hit).
Ice Lance against frozen targets drops to +200% (was +300%).
Winter's Chill no longer adds crit. Each stack now makes your next Cone of Cold hit 40% harder, up to 5 stacks.
New Frost Blast at level 24: 1.5 sec cast, 40% slow, uses every Frostbolt talent. Replaces kiting with rank 1 Frostbolt.
Cone of Cold slows the first 4 targets an extra 10% for 3 more seconds. Frostbite and Fingers of Frost now proc from Frost and Ice Armor.
Bug fixes that favoured Mages: Presence of Mind is now consumed, Clearcasting no longer rolls per target or off out-of-combat casts, Missile Barrage can't discount a second Missiles.
Racials: Human gets Ruthless (+2% crit), Orc gets Savage (+1% crit) but Blood Fury is now 3 min, Skyborne haste goes to 3%, Troll Regeneration doubles.
Moonkin Aura (spell crit) is now raid-wide and stacks with Leader of the Pack.

verdict.body: On MythicSim's newest engine (a667dce, 21 Oct, client 70425) Fire sims 860 DPS, about 9% ahead of Arcane (791). The experimental Frostfire hybrid sits at 768 and Frost at 666, about 23% behind Fire. The tier list (same engine) agrees: Fire #6 and Arcane #9 of 24, both in the A band; Frostfire is #13 (B) and Frost is #21 in the C band. Fire has gained the most since 16 Oct (696 to 860), and MythicSim's breakdown credits +4.6% to an engine sync where every Fire Blast now adds a Heating Up charge. Fire is the sim pick for raids now; level as Frost.
